As discussed in last week's GTM planning session, I’m submitting a consolidated ask for Q2 GTM increments. The attached spreadsheet breaks the request into three buckets: Sales (AE), Customer Success (Senior CSM), and Solutions Engineering (Sr SE / IC lead). High level:

- 3x Enterprise AEs (SALARY + OTE adjustments for competitive markets)
- 2x Senior CSMs (to reduce churn risk on three seven-figure deals)

I would like to get an initial greenlight this week so People Ops can start offers and we can keep recruiting momentum.

Attachments: q2_gtm_headcount_request.xlsx, comp_band_proposal.pdf

1) Finance sanity check + Laura sign-off on headcount and cost impact
2) Marissa to confirm CSM capacity plan and priority accounts
3) Vivek to confirm SE scope and whether we can convert an existing contractor

Please reply with approvals or any redlines.

Thanks,

Thanks for the clear packet. I skimmed the numbers and we should be able to accommodate the headcount within the Q2 operating plan, but I need two immediate clarifications before greenlighting:

1) Comp band uplift: the Bay Area AE target increase looks aggressive; supply-side comps have moderated in Jan and Feb. Can you call out which roles are critical to price at the top of band vs. which are flexible?
2) Ramp & quota impact: for 3 AEs, what is the expected blended ramp timeline and when do we see revenue coverage? Put that in a one-pager and I can sign off.

If the one-pager answers these, I’ll give provisional approval and loop Finance for formal sign-off.
